name: Quality
description: ESS-0005 Quality Center core: validator registry integration, non-authorizing Governance/Compliance orchestration, eight-gate evidence evaluation, deterministic quality scoring, technical-debt management, measured test-area coverage, QM documentation consistency and EventMesh lifecycle publication.

events.note: QualityCenterOrchestrator publishes lifecycle evidence through the existing EventMesh composition adapter. Event delivery has no merge/release/production authorization effect. TechnicalDebtDetectedEvent/TechnicalDebtResolvedEvent remain catalogued target events until debt mutations are wired to an event sink.

implementedAreas: CoverageCollector with executable-test-area measurement and optional code-coverage ingestion
real Test Score provider from mandatory test-area coverage
real Security Score provider from established SecurityComplianceAuditor aggregation semantics
EventMesh lifecycle publication through existing EventBus
remainingContractScope: complete evidence coverage for Contract/Test/Build and all eight quality gates
complete coverage of all mandatory Chapter-12 validators
measured providers for Documentation, Architecture, Knowledge, Metadata and Twin score axes
TechnicalDebtDetectedEvent and TechnicalDebtResolvedEvent publication from debt mutation operations
line/branch/function/statement coverage requires a real coverage-summary artifact and remains NOT_AVAILABLE when absent

authorityBoundary: Quality results are measurement/evidence only and cannot authorize merge, release, deployment, production mutation, policy changes or privilege elevation.
